from pathlib import Path
import sys,json,hashlib,time,resource,signal,ast
import sympy as s
from sympy.polys.matrices import DomainMatrix
sys.path.insert(0,'code')
from classification_three_hyperplanes_quadric_independent import ambient_matrices
from classification_rank3_mixed_component_review import COLUMNS,ROWS
root=Path('.');begun=time.monotonic();signal.alarm(180);resource.setrlimit(resource.RLIMIT_AS,(3072*1024**2,)*2)
job=json.loads((root/'research/classification/jobs/cubic_cone_rank_two_one_orbit_ambient.json').read_bytes())
for r in job['exact_inputs_and_hashes']:assert hashlib.sha256((root/r['path']).read_bytes()).hexdigest()==r['sha256'],r['path']
old=json.loads((root/'reports/CLASSIFICATION_CUBIC_CONE_RANK_TWO_FOUR_CRITICAL_SOURCES_20261108.json').read_bytes())
case=next(c for c in old['cases']if c['case']=='A_ss'and c['lambda']=='3/5')
x=s.symbols('x0:5');k=s.symbols('k0:6');env={str(t):t for t in (*x,*k)};values={k[0]:1,k[5]:2,**{t:0 for t in k[1:5]}}
point=s.zeros(5)
for key,text in case['all_actual_brackets'].items():
 i,j=ast.literal_eval(key);point[i,j]=s.expand(s.sympify(text,locals=env).subs(values));point[j,i]=-point[i,j]
scale=s.ilcm(*[co.q for i in range(5)for j in range(i+1,5)for co in s.Poly(point[i,j],*x).coeffs()])
P=point*scale;assert scale>0
# Same all27source point, with a nonzero rational clearing only.
q0=x[0]*x[2]-x[1]**2;q1=x[0]*x[3]-x[1]*x[2];q2=x[1]*x[3]-x[2]**2
expected=x[4]*q0*q2+q2*(x[2]*q2-x[3]*q1)+q0*(x[0]*q1-x[1]*q0)
actual=s.expand(sum((-1)**i*x[i]*(P[a,b]*P[c,d]-P[a,c]*P[b,d]+P[a,d]*P[b,c])for i in range(5)for a,b,c,d in [[j for j in range(5)if j!=i]]));assert actual==s.expand(scale**2*expected)
D,V,M,extra=ambient_matrices(P,x,[P]);assert extra==M.row_join(M[:,-1])
def encode(a):return {'shape':list(a.shape),'entries':{str(i)+','+str(j):str(c)for(i,j),c in a.todok().items()}}
def certificate(a):
 dm=DomainMatrix.from_Matrix(a).convert_to(s.QQ);rr,piv=dm.rref();rr=rr.to_Matrix();piv=list(piv);free=[j for j in range(a.cols)if j not in piv];K=s.zeros(a.cols,len(free))
 for ell,j in enumerate(free):
  K[j,ell]=1
  for i,p in enumerate(piv):K[p,ell]=-rr[i,j]
 assert a*K==s.zeros(a.rows,K.cols)and K[free,:]==s.eye(len(free))
 rows=list(DomainMatrix.from_Matrix(a[:,piv].T).convert_to(s.QQ).rref()[1]);det=DomainMatrix.from_Matrix(a.extract(rows,piv)).convert_to(s.QQ).det();assert det
 return {'rank':len(piv),'nullity':len(free),'minor_rows':rows,'minor_columns':piv,'minor_determinant':str(det),'full_kernel':encode(K),'free_columns':free,'all_original_rows_times_kernel_zero':True,'free_coordinate_identity':True}
matrices={'full350_D':D,'Euler25':V,'Euler_GL5_scalar51':M};certs={name:certificate(a)for name,a in matrices.items()};ranks={name:c['rank']for name,c in certs.items()}
assert ranks['Euler25']==24 and D*M==s.zeros(350,51)
orbit=ranks['Euler_GL5_scalar51']-25;tangent=125-ranks['full350_D'];normal=tangent-orbit;assert normal>=0
paths=['code/classification_three_hyperplanes_quadric_independent.py','code/classification_rank3_mixed_component_review.py']
report={'task_id':'E_reduced_nonnormal','all_exact_arithmetic_passed':True,
 'same_whole_orbit_canonical_point':{'source':'A_ss lambda3/5','kernel_values':{'k0':1,'k5':2,'k1':0,'k2':0,'k3':0,'k4':0},'integer_clearing_scale':int(scale),'coordinate_order':list(map(str,x))},
 'all_actual_point_brackets':{str((i,j)):str(P[i,j])for i in range(5)for j in range(i+1,5)},
 'all350_original_Jacobi_zero':True,'actual_signed_Euler_Pfaffian':str(actual),'actualF_equals_canonical_primitive_quintic_times_scale_squared':True,
 'full_original_coefficient_order':[{'pair':list(ij),'exponent':list(e)}for ij,e in COLUMNS],
 'full_original_equation_order':[{'quad':list(ij),'exponent':list(e)}for ij,e in ROWS],
 'complete_sparse_matrices':{name:encode(a)for name,a in matrices.items()},'complete_rank_minor_kernel_certificates':certs,
 'ranks_QQ':ranks,'all_D_times_actual51_zero':True,
 'actual_projective_orbit_dimension':orbit,'full_projective_tangent_dimension':tangent,'normal_quotient_dimension':normal,
 'smooth_unique_full_component_proved':orbit==tangent,'actual_orbitclosure_full_component_proved':orbit==tangent,
 'no_component_count_increment_before_independent_geometry_and_prior_audit':True,'new_component_count':0,
 'next_branch':'If smooth24, knownT36/T37/T38/otherprior recognition or fullnewness audit; ifD100 one actual normal curve/knownparent geometry withoutjets; lowerstoplocalroute.',
 'input_bindings':job['exact_inputs_and_hashes'],'inline_source':job['inline_source'],'inline_source_sha256':job['inline_source_sha256'],
 'exact_helper_source_snapshots':[{'path':p,'sha256':hashlib.sha256((root/p).read_bytes()).hexdigest(),'source_bytes':(root/p).read_text()}for p in paths],
 'ONE_canonical_whole_orbit_only_no_profiles_or_newanchors':True,'seconds':time.monotonic()-begun,'maximum_RSS_KiB':resource.getrusage(resource.RUSAGE_SELF).ru_maxrss}
p=root/'reports/CLASSIFICATION_CUBIC_CONE_RANK_TWO_ONE_ORBIT_AMBIENT_20261108.json'
with p.open('x')as f:json.dump(report,f,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2);f.write('\n')
print(json.dumps({'all_exact_arithmetic_passed':True,'ranks_QQ':ranks,'orbit':orbit,'tangent':tangent,'normal':normal,'seconds':report['seconds'],'maximum_RSS_KiB':report['maximum_RSS_KiB']}))
